item.title: Corruption 101: Nvidia Reinstates Philanderer Jensen Huang Following Pressure From Donald Trump
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Trump pressured Nvidia's board to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang after his resignation. Huang's return sparked a 33% stock surge, while Trump's investment accounts profited $27M-$97.5M from Nvidia trades.
item.content:encoded:
Need to Know

To the shock and dismay of the entire world, Nvidia announced on Monday that it voted unanimously to reinstate the disgraced CEO and cofounder, effective immediately. A decision that took many in the business world by surprise.

  • Huang resigned in disgrace after his extramarital affairs, one of them an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, but was reinstated following multiple calls from Trump pushing for him to be put back in the CEO role.
  • As expected, the cheating CEO’s shocking reinstatement, after the board claimed it saw no national security risk in his return, after speaking with Trump, saw shares in the company soar 33%.
  • Trump, who isn’t shy about being corrupt and wants Huang back, claiming he’s protecting our geniuses, was called into CNBC and said, “If I didn’t get involved, you’d probably have a, a very sad Nvidia, for a long time to come.”

Donald Trump isn’t letting the threat of impending investigations stop him from being the corrupt president of the United States that he is. The orange menace revealed that he was directly involved in helping Nvidia bring back Jensen Huang.

To the shock and dismay of the entire world, Nvidia announced on Monday that it voted unanimously to reinstate the disgraced CEO and cofounder, effective immediately. A decision that took many in the business world by surprise.

Huang resigned in disgrace after his extramarital affairs, one of them an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, but was reinstated following multiple calls from Trump pushing for him to be put back in the CEO role.

As expected, the cheating CEO’s shocking reinstatement, after the board claimed it saw no national security risk in his return, after speaking with Trump, saw shares in the company soar 33%.

The decision also comes as the US SEC and the Department of Justice are conducting multiple investigations into the company for alleged accounting issues and alleged chip smuggling.

Trump, who isn’t shy about being corrupt and wants Huang back, claiming he’s protecting our geniuses, was called into CNBC and said, “If I didn’t get involved, you’d probably have a, a very sad Nvidia, for a long time to come.”

His meddling has the stock market on a sugar high at the moment, helping out your 401Ks, but it’s also helping out Orange Mussolini.

There is already video of Huang returning to Nvidia HQ to loud applause, but we wouldn’t be shocked if people are just clapping and celebrating because he’s the boss.

CNBC reports that since his unfortunate return to the White House, Trump’s investment accounts “have bought and sold Nvidia shares at least 103 times – transactions worth a combined $27 million to $97.5 million.”

Donald Trump Runs To Truth Social To Post A Ridiculous Meme

In typical Trump fashion, he took to his crappy platform, Truth Social, to post about Nvidia’s eye-opening decision, sharing a photoshopped image of Huang in place of Trump following the failed “assassination plot” in Butler, Pennsylvania, with Huang holding up a red bra.

Bruh.

We only expect this situation to escalate, especially when the Democrats take control of the government, but until then, you can see the reactions to this president’s unchecked corruption below.

item.title: Fire Performer Falls Off Stage During Usher And Chris Brown Tour
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: Usher and Chris Brown’s joint tour has suffered another dramatic moment after a fire performer was caught falling off the stage during their New Orleans show. Video circulating on social media shows the performer twirling what appears to be several flaming props while moving across the stage. At one point, the performer begins walking backward […]
item.content:encoded:
Usher and Chris Brown’s joint tour has suffered another dramatic moment after a fire performer was caught falling off the stage during their New Orleans show.

Video circulating on social media shows the performer twirling what appears to be several flaming props while moving across the stage. At one point, the performer begins walking backward before suddenly losing their footing and tumbling down a flight of stairs, TMZ reports. 

It’s unclear whether the performer suffered any injuries, but the fall certainly wasn’t part of the choreography.

And apparently, the tour can’t seem to go too long without something happening.

Earlier this month, TMZ reported that Usher and Brown got into a heated backstage argument during one of their Atlanta performances.

According to sources, the singers’ egos reportedly got the better of them after fans experienced delays getting into the stadium because of traffic. The two allegedly disagreed over how to handle the situation, resulting in a backstage confrontation.

Their respective teams have reportedly been working overtime to get the singers to sit down, talk through their differences and repair whatever damage has been done to their working relationship.

Because nothing says a successful concert partnership quite like needing a diplomatic intervention between two R&B superstars.

Meanwhile, the fire performer incident is the latest unexpected development to hit the tour, which has already generated headlines for reasons that have little to do with the music.

TMZ reached out to representatives for Chris Brown, Usher and Live Nation have been for comment about the performer’s condition. So far, no one has responded.

item.dc:creator: Matty Willz
item.description: Kanye West Delivers a Career-Spanning Performance in Arizona Kanye West, now known as Ye, reminded fans just how deep his musical catalog runs during a massive concert in Arizona over the weekend. The Chicago rapper and producer took over State Farm Stadium in Glendale, just outside Phoenix, on Saturday, November 21, delivering a performance that […]
item.content:encoded:
Kanye West Delivers a Career-Spanning Performance in Arizona

Kanye West, now known as Ye, reminded fans just how deep his musical catalog runs during a massive concert in Arizona over the weekend.

The Chicago rapper and producer took over State Farm Stadium in Glendale, just outside Phoenix, on Saturday, November 21, delivering a performance that stretched across more than two decades of Hip Hop history.

From early classics like “Jesus Walks” and “Through the Wire” to stadium anthems like “Stronger,” “POWER” and “All of the Lights,” Ye gave longtime supporters plenty to celebrate.

The nearly two-and-a-half-hour show also featured newer material from his BULLY era, proving that his extensive catalog continues to play a major role in his live performances.

Big Sean Joins Ye For a Surprise Reunion

One of the night’s biggest highlights came when Big Sean joined Ye onstage.

The Detroit rapper reunited with his former G.O.O.D. Music boss for performances of “Mercy,” “Clique” and Sean’s smash hit “I Don’t F**k With You.”

The concert also featured appearances from André Troutman, who contributed to several songs, including “Heartless” and “Flashing Lights.”

Ye’s Phoenix performance followed major stadium shows in Houston and Arlington, Texas, as part of his 2026 concert run.

While the rapper’s career has been surrounded by controversy in recent years, his latest performance put the spotlight back on the music that helped establish him as one of Hip Hop’s most influential artists.

And with a setlist approaching 50 entries, there was something for fans of nearly every Kanye era.

Check out the full setlist from Kanye West’s November 21 Phoenix-area concert below.

item.title: Cyclops Says The Thing In Epic Final Trailer For ‘Avengers: Doomsday’
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Marvel's Avengers: Doomsday final trailer drops epic reveals: Steve Rogers' secret family, Doom with witches, incursions, and Cyclops' iconic X-Men assembly line. Arrives December 18.
item.content:encoded:
Need to Know

The world pressed pause on Grand Theft Auto 6 to watch the final trailer for Marvel Studios’ next team-up film, Avengers: Doomsday, and damn, did it slap.

  • The trailer focuses mainly on Steve Rogers (Chris Evans) after the events of Avengers: Endgame, where he returned the stones but didn’t return to his timeline; instead, he ran back to the past to live his dream life with Peggy Carter (Hayley Atwell) and get that dance.
  • We also finally see an incursion, which is basically two worlds literally crashing
    into each other: Sam Wilson/Captain America (Anthony Mackie) battling Cyclops (James Marsden), and much more.
  • The one moment in the trailer that has everyone hyped and ready to run through a wall is Cyclops delivering the iconic “to me, my X-Men” line, setting up another epic hero shot.

If you’re a nerd, or blerd, you seriously have to sit back and say to yourself, “What a time to be alive.” Marvel Studios delivered the final trailer for Avengers: Doomsday, and it was nothing short of epic.

The world pressed pause on Grand Theft Auto 6 to watch the final trailer for Marvel Studios’ next team-up film, Avengers: Doomsday, and damn, did it slap.

The trailer focuses mainly on Steve Rogers (Chris Evans) after the events of Avengers: Endgame, where he returned the stones but didn’t return to his timeline; instead, he ran back to the past to live his dream life with Peggy Carter (Hayley Atwell) and get that dance.

We knew from the first trailer that Steve and Peggy had a child, but the final look at the film reveals that years have passed. The couple’s kid is a teen, but the former Captain America reveals that his son has no idea who he really is, with Peggy reassuring him that their child knows who his father is.

Anyway, the Fantastic Four show up at their home, and Mr. Fantastic (Pedro Pascal) asks if Steve is THEE Steve Rogers. His son walks in on the meeting, learns that his dad was a hero, and Steve comes clean, telling him about the Avengers.

From there, we get plenty of new shots like Doom (Robert Downey Jr.) walking with his three witches, one of them rumored to be Wanda Maximoff / Scarlet Witch (Elizabeth Olsen), after that life-changing VisionQuest post-credit scene that showed Doom reviving Wanda, who allowed herself to be crushed under the rubble of Mount Wundagore in Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness.

We also finally see an incursion, which is basically two worlds literally crashing into each other: Sam Wilson/Captain America (Anthony Mackie) battling it out with Cyclops (James Marsden), and much more.

The one moment in the trailer that has everyone hyped and ready to run through a wall is Cyclops delivering the iconic “to me, my X-Men” line, setting up another epic hero shot.

Bruh, to say we have waited YEARS to not only see Scott in his comic-accurate suit, but also to see him confidently assemble his squad with that line is an understatement.

Avengers: Doomsday arrives in theaters December 18, and honestly, that day can’t arrive any sooner.

But until it does, assemble below like the Avengers and peep the reactions to the latest look at the highly anticipated superhero flick below.

item.title: Diddy’s 2026 Thanksgiving Prison Meal Has Been Shared
item.dc:creator: Weso
item.description: Diddy will be spending his second consecutive Thanksgiving behind bars, but that doesn’t mean he’ll be missing out on a holiday feast. The menu for the infamous music executive’s Thanksgiving meal has reportedly been announced, and it looks like he’ll have a few options to choose from. Although the Bad Boy Records founder is currently […]
item.content:encoded:
Diddy will be spending his second consecutive Thanksgiving behind bars, but that doesn’t mean he’ll be missing out on a holiday feast. 

The menu for the infamous music executive’s Thanksgiving meal has reportedly been announced, and it looks like he’ll have a few options to choose from. Although the Bad Boy Records founder is currently serving time in prison, it appears he’ll still be eating good this holiday season.

According to Page Six, Diddy will reportedly have the option of choosing between turkey of an Asian fusion tofu stir-fry as his main course.

Alongside the main dish, the holiday spread will include green bean casserole, sage, and onion stuffing, and mashed potato casserole. If Puff has room for dessert, he’ll also have the option of enjoying some pecan pie.

This isn’t the first time the music mogul has had an extensive menu for a special occasion behind bars. For his birthday, Diddy was also reportedly treated to a lengthy menu/

With plenty of time left on his sentence, Diddy has several more holidays to figure out what he’ll be eating behind bars. He’s currently scheduled to be released in February 2028, although his projected release date has reportedly changed more than 10 times.

Depending on his conduct and eligibility for time credits, Diddy could potentially leave FCI Allenwood Low earlier than expected. Until then, Thanksgiving, Christmas, and other special occasions will continue to looks different for the once-celebrated executive.

item.title: It Only Took 24 Hours For ‘GTA 6’ To Beat ‘Avengers: Endgame’s Lifetime Box Office
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Take-Two Interactive confirmed the official sales numbers for GTA 6, revealing it moved 32.5 million units before its official release on Nov. 19 and brought in an estimated $3.79 billion in revenue through launch.
item.content:encoded:
Remember that protest, “no physical, no buy”? Well, it appears it didn’t work, and gamers put GTA 6 on a fast track to make it the most profitable piece of entertainment ever.

Take-Two Interactive confirmed the official sales numbers for GTA 6, revealing it moved 32.5 million units before its official release on Nov. 19 and brought in an estimated $3.79 billion in revenue through launch.

According to Rockstar Games, those numbers signify that its preorder sales record across all consoles made GTA 6 the “biggest entertainment launch in history.”

“It is with immense gratitude that we enter a new chapter of Rockstar Games with the release of Grand Theft Auto VI,” said Rockstar Games president and cofounder Sam Houser in a press release. “We are incredibly humbled by the response from players around the world, and we couldn’t be more excited to share this moment with you.”

GTA 6 Dominated Playtime on Both The PS5 & XBOX Series X/S Consoles

Circana’s senior director Matt Piscatella reports the game drew the spotlight for engagement on the PS5 and Xbox Series X/S during the first 24 hours after release.

Piscatella reports that 65 percent of PS5 players in the US played on launch day, along with 56 percent of Xbox gamers globally, and that players across both consoles averaged 494 minutes of playtime. Fortnite was the second-most-played game, with just 10 percent of active users across both PlayStation and XBOX.

“To put this into perspective, Grand Theft Auto IV sold 25 million units across five years. Grand Theft Auto V sold 11 million copies on its first day and generated $800 million,” Niko Partners analyst Daniel Ahmad wrote on X (formerly Twitter). “And that’s comparing it to GTA. Other games don’t come close.”

GTA 6 sold well on its first day, surpassing Hollywood’s biggest blockbuster, Avengers: Endgame, which currently holds the box office record at $2.94 billion following multiple theatrical runs.

The game is selling so well that its day-one revenue equals the combined box office of The Odyssey and Avengers: Infinity War.

Bruh.

When it’s all said and done, GTA 6 will be the most successful piece of entertainment ever made; you can book it.

You can see more reactions below.

item.title: Trump Supporter Waka Flocka Bashes Adult Gamers For Playing ‘GTA 6,’ Social Media Fries Him
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Waka Flocka criticized 35-year-old gamers excited about GTA 6, but backfired spectacularly: his song is on the soundtrack, he co-owned a gaming company, and he's played Mortal Kombat for money at 37.
item.content:encoded:
Waka Flocka isn’t here for adult gamers being excited about GTA 6.

Nobody asked him, but proud Donald Trump supporter Waka Flocka, who isn’t busy, might we add, due to his floundering rap career, decided to chime in on the buzz regarding GTA 6. If you guessed it was because he was being a hater, you are absolutely correct.

While driving somewhere, the “No Hands” rapper aimed at 35-year-old gamers, specifically men, claiming they “don’t wanna win” becuase they are too focused on spending their well-deserved free time, because life is already hard enough thanks to his favorite president playing GTA 6 instead of getting money.

In the words of the honorable Councilman Tate from Power, N*** What?

If anyone knows a thing or two about losing, it should be Waka Flocka Flame, who happily threw his support behind one of the most unpopular presidents in U.S. history. In fact, Trump is so trash he helped deep red states like Mississippi and Texas turn blue for the first time in years following the blue tsunami.

Anyway, as expected, the struggle rapper is getting the wrath of social media for sharing his unwarranted opinion that adults are excited about a video game they have been waiting 13 years to play.

One user pointed out that Waka Flocka’s song is in the GTA 6 soundtrack, he co-owns a gaming company, and there is literally video of a 37-year-old Waka Flocka playing Mortal Kombat for money.

“This is hilarious considering THREE things: 1. Waka Flocka’s own song (“O Let’s Do It”) is literally on the GTA 6 radio soundtrack, meaning he cashed a check from these exact gamers 2. He co-owned a gaming company and was playing Mortal Kombat money matches at 37 3. GTA 5 came out 13 years ago, a 22-year-old who played it on launch is literally 35 today Bro is calling his own customers pathetic,” one user on X (formerly Twitter) brilliantly pointed out.

Another social media user wrote, “This is coming from a 40 year old that goes by Waka Flocka Flame?”

Bruh.

Consider this a self-own because, honestly, silence was an option, and he could have kept his mouth shut, downloaded GTA 6, and gotten in on the fun.

Welp, we are here for the well-deserved dragging, and you can see those reactions below.

item.title: Woman Arrested For Stalking Eminem, Claims He’s The Father of Her Child & Vladimir Putin Is Her Daddy
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: Eminem has remained out the spotlight for quite some time now and though he doesn’t have the same cultish following that he had in the early 2000’s, he does apparently still have at least one fan stalking him in 2026. According to the Detroit Free Press, Nicole Savage was arrested and charged with aggravated stalking […]
item.content:encoded:
Eminem has remained out the spotlight for quite some time now and though he doesn’t have the same cultish following that he had in the early 2000’s, he does apparently still have at least one fan stalking him in 2026.

According to the Detroit Free Press, Nicole Savage was arrested and charged with aggravated stalking the Grammy award winning rapper’s Clinton Township home this past October 27th. Interestingly enough this is more than just your average Eminem “Stan” taking things too far as the 46-year-old woman not only claimed that Eminem was the father to her child (could be), but that she herself was the daughter of Russian President, Vladimir Putin and was a Russian operative whose real name was Natalia Putin.

In this day and age of Donald Trump, that too could be very well true. Just sayin.’

Naturally, police arrested Savage after the October incident and will have her undergo a competency exam as she doesn’t seem to be with us on Earth 1.

Per The Detroit Free Press:

She was scheduled for a preliminary exam and motion hearing Thursday, Nov. 19, in 41B District Court in Clinton Township. Because of the ruling for a competency exam, her next court date is set for Jan. 25, according to the prosecutor’s office and county jail online records.

According to the prosecutors’ motion, Savage’s parents also provided a written memorandum to prosecutors and the court highlighting her “seriously deteriorating mental state.” They describe her history of mental illness, including a purported diagnosis of schizophrenic bipolar disorder that resulted in hospitalizations and medications, which she has ceased to follow, according to the motion dated Nov. 16.

Savage’s parents also said that her behavior was becoming more “aggressive” and her “general thought process has become fragmented and riddled with bizarre illusions.”

It had gotten to the point where she began making death threats to both her parents and her ex-husband before making her way to Eminem’s estate this past October.

She must’ve been a huge fan of his back in the day to have carried that kind of delusion into 2026.

Interestingly enough Savage was arrested back on August 1st at Eminem’s estate and charged with stalking and trespass before once again getting pinched for the same thing in October.

Her family hopes the court orders rehabilitation as she is being held in the county jail on a $250,000 cash or surety bond.

We wonder if she bought his new album.

What do y’all think about this wild case? Let us know your thoughts in the comments section below.

item.title: Unreleased D’Angelo Track Reportedly Appears In Grand Theft Auto VI
item.dc:creator: paige.boyd
item.description: An unreleased D'Angelo track, "Kamikaze," is reportedly featured in Grand Theft Auto VI on the Worldwide FM station.
item.content:encoded:
An unreleased track from the late D’Angelo has reportedly made its way into Grand Theft Auto VI.

As reported by Hot New Hip Hop, the track “Kamikaze” is featured on the game’s multi-genre Worldwide FM station alongside tracks by Roberta Flack, Jamiroquai, Digable Planets, and more. Another D’Angelo jam, his classic “Lady,” can be found on the Honey FM station.

The features are the latest link in the late singer’s connection to Rockstar Games, the company behind GTA VI. D’Angelo previously worked with Rockstar on the soundtrack to Red Dead Redemption 2 and performed “Unshaken” in the game.

Upon news of his death in October 2025, Rockstar Games paid tribute, calling him “a true titan of soul” and saying they were “eternally grateful” for his contributions to the game.

Neither Rockstar Games nor D’Angelo’s estate confirmed the unreleased track in GTA VI. However, the fact that D’Angelo is included at all is enough for fans to give their flowers on social media. Check out some of the reactions below:

item.title: Producer Claims Kanye West Fans Threatened To Kill Him And His Family
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: A music producer who is suing Kanye West over unpaid work is now claiming that he and his family have received death threats from the rapper’s fans. A Los Angeles judge has allowed the unnamed producer to remain anonymous and to proceed with the court filing using the pseudonym John Doe during the pretrial phase. […]
item.content:encoded:
A music producer who is suing Kanye West over unpaid work is now claiming that he and his family have received death threats from the rapper’s fans.

A Los Angeles judge has allowed the unnamed producer to remain anonymous and to proceed with the court filing using the pseudonym John Doe during the pretrial phase.

According to court documents obtained by TMZ, the judge approved the producer’s request to keep his name private on Wednesday after reviewing evidence in private. In the judge’s filing, the producer claimed that Ye’s supporters threatened to track him down and kill him. He also claimed that his family received the same kind of threats. 

Additionally, the producer accused a worker for West of intimidating him while encouraging the fans behavior. The judge ultimately found that protecting the producer outweighed the public’s interest in knowing the producer’s identity. But the ruling did not that the protection is limited. 

While the producer is allowed to go under John Doe in public court records and during pretrial proceedings, the ruling did not extend to the trial. Ye’s legal team is also allowed to have the producer’s real name while they are investigating the case.

The dispute between the producer and West began in August, when the producer filed a lawsuit against Ye and his companies claiming that he was not paid for his contributions to two West albums Vultures 2 and Bully. 

John Doe claims that he was brought on to help with Vultures 2 just two days before its scheduled release. During that time, the producer claims that he created more than 400 AI generated vocal recordings ans some 13 custom AI voice models. 

“According to the lawsuit, his work appeared on five Vultures 2 tracks and two released songs from Bully. He also alleges that Ye’s team acknowledged his contributions in late 2024. Moreover, he discussed correcting his streaming credits and offered a master buyout. However, he claims they never followed through with payment or proper recognition,” Yahoo reports.

The producer alleges that after his work he repeatedly tried to contact West and his business managers to receive payment. He’s seeking $110,000–$80,000 for his work on Vultures 2 and $30,000 for Bully. This amount included additional damages for his unreleased work. The producer also asked the court to require West to give him the proper music credit for his work.

item.title: MC Eiht Explains Why He Didn’t Get Involved In The East Coast/West Coast Beef In The Late 90’s
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: The East Coast/West Coast “war” of the late 90’s will go down as one of the wildest period’s of the rap game in Hip-Hop history and while some rappers took potshots at entire cities to show solidarity with their own, West Coast rap legend, MC Eiht refrained from joining the fray and finally reveals why. […]
item.content:encoded:
The East Coast/West Coast “war” of the late 90’s will go down as one of the wildest period’s of the rap game in Hip-Hop history and while some rappers took potshots at entire cities to show solidarity with their own, West Coast rap legend, MC Eiht refrained from joining the fray and finally reveals why.

In a recent interview with Sway on Sway’s Universe, MC Eiht spoke about how he had love for New York and New York rappers he met in the beginning of his career which is one of the reasons he kept from participating in the East vs. West rap battles of the late 90’s.

When asked if anyone ever pressured him to take sides during the height of the beef, Eiht responded, “No. No. I was always my own crew, Sway. We were never a part of anybody’s agenda,” before adding, “I don’t wanna be beefing with muthaf*ckas who I feel gave us this lane… Hip-Hop came outta New York. I don’t give a f*ck.”

Well, he’s not wrong. Though the rap battle was labeled an “East Coast/West Coast War,” Hip-Hoppers from that era remember it was really a Death Row Records vs. Bad Boy Records affair with Tupac and The Notorious B.I.G. at the heart of it all. Then The Dogg Pound dropped “New York, New York,” which resulted in Capone-N-Noreaga and Mobb Deep responding with “L.A., L.A.” and then Tupac roping in Nas, Mobb Deep, Jay-Z and even LL Cool J into the mix and things kind of went from there.

It. Was. Crazy.

Check out MC Eiht talk about the East Coast/West Coast beef of the late 90’s at around the 24-minute mark and let us know your thoughts about his stance in the comments section below.

item.title: MAGA Regrets: Elon Musk Says He’s No Longer A Member of Donald Trump’s Cult
item.dc:creator: Bernard "Beanz" Smalls
item.description: Elon Musk claims he regrets spending $500M on GOP candidates and now distances himself from MAGA, despite being on record as 'Ultra MAGA.' Critics say he's flip-flopping as Democrats gain power.
item.content:encoded:
Bootleg Tony Stark, aka Elon Musk, is now regretting putting on the new Klan hood, aka the MAGA cap, and dropping bags of money on the now powerless Republican Party.

You hear that Elon? No, it’s not the rev of an engine in one of your overrated Tesla vehicles, but it’s the sound of the walls beginning to close in on you as the Democrats who seized control of the sinking ship that is the US Government begin to zero in on the corruption that took place unchecked for the last two years.

During an interview at the New York Times DealBook Summit, Musk now claims he felt “foolish” for backing up the Brink’s truck for the GOP during the midterm elections and spending nearly $500 million to get Republican candidates elected.

He also downplayed his involvement in the MAGA movement, saying he is no longer down with it.

“I feel pretty foolish about having spent so much money and not seeing much for it, or maybe it would have been much worse without that,” Musk said, appearing virtually during the interview.

“But it certainly shows that you know American elections are not just about money. You know, obviously you can put a lot of money into election and have an effect that is relatively minor, and I think that that was the case here. So probably I could rewind the clock. I would have spent less money,” Musk added.

Following the Democrats’ blue tsunami, Musk knows investigations are coming, so during the interview he tried to pitch himself as more of a moderate, not hardcore MAGA, even though he is on record calling himself “Ultra MAGA” and “dark gothic MAGA.”

“So, you know, I think I’m ideologically quite moderate, although you know, I don’t think I have like you know any kind of extreme political views,” Musk said.

“I’m not MAGA. Well, at least I’m not like, I’m not sure what MAGA means … If that means sort of blind adherence to a set of policies by the Republican Party, then I certainly don’t have that. I think there are there are positives and negatives in both parties,” so basically, he’s now lying.

Someone tell Elon that we have enough 4K footage of him being all in on the MAGA movement, just saying.

As expected, Musk is getting flamed on his app; you can see those reactions below.

item.title: GTA 6 Soundtrack: Every Hip-Hop Song Found So Far
item.dc:creator: Matty Willz
item.description: GTA 6's soundtrack features 47 hip-hop tracks spanning Drake, Travis Scott, and Southern legends like Three 6 Mafia, blending trap anthems with Miami classics for Vice City cruising.
item.content:encoded:
Grand Theft Auto VI has officially arrived, and alongside the action, chaos and sprawling streets of Vice City comes a soundtrack loaded with Hip-Hop heavyweights.

Rockstar Games has once again delivered an impressive collection of music, blending today’s biggest rap stars with legendary artists who helped shape the genre. From chart-topping hits to timeless Southern classics, GTA 6 gives players plenty to turn up while cruising through Leonida.

Drake, Travis Scott, Future, Playboi Carti, Young Thug and Cardi B are among the familiar names featured throughout the game’s expansive musical lineup.

| Rap Legend Yo-Yo Talks About Her Character in ‘Grand Theft Auto’

Hip-Hop Takes Over Vice City

Music has always been an essential part of the Grand Theft Auto experience, but GTA 6 puts a particularly strong spotlight on Southern Hip-Hop and its influence on the culture.

One of the game’s standout stations is Dirty South Classics, hosted by Miami rap legends Trick Daddy and Trina. The station celebrates the records that helped put Southern rap on the map, including music from Three 6 Mafia, David Banner and other influential artists.

Of course, the soundtrack isn’t limited to throwback favorites. Modern trap, mainstream rap and contemporary Hip-Hop hits are well represented.

| Gamers Are Baffled By Rockstar Games’ $400 ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’: Vice City Collection

Whether you’re completing missions or simply riding through Vice City, there’s no shortage of music to keep the speakers knocking.

Check out the Hip-Hop songs featured in GTA 6 below.

GTA 6 Hip-Hop Soundtrack: 47 Songs Connected To The Game

Drake & Hip-Hop’s Biggest Hits

Drake – “Nonstop”

One of the standout records from Drake’s 2018 album Scorpion, “Nonstop” delivers a bass-heavy beat and plenty of quotable bars. It’s exactly the kind of record that belongs on a Vice City rap station.

Drake – “Nokia”

Drake’s 2025 hit brings a bouncy, nostalgic energy to the soundtrack. Its infectious production makes it a natural choice for cruising through the city’s neon-lit streets.

Drake – “Hold On, We’re Going Home”

Drake’s smooth 2013 collaboration with Majid Jordan offers a change of pace from the harder rap selections. The melodic hit remains one of his most recognizable crossover records.

item.content:encoded:
Just a few years ago the Travis Scott x Nike collaborations would hit the block with an impact like crack in the 80’s and though that particular partnership has since cooled off in popularity their new Grand Theft Auto VI inspired collection could change that.

With less than 24 hours to go before gamers finally get to indulge in the long-awaited world of Grand Theft Auto, Nike, Travis Scott and Rockstar Games have revealed their capsule collection for the game which includes some exclusive Air Force 1’s that’s sure to be a hit with hype beasts and video gamers alike.

According to Complex, their new capsule collection will consist of a few Air Force 1’s which will feature Travis Scott’s signature reverse Nike swoosh on the sides along with some tees and hoodies inspired by the videogame. Along with the sneakers some pretty spiffy hoodies and tees will also be dropping and truth be told, this is some of the dopest attire we’ve seen Nike release in a long time.

Per Complex:

Nike and Cactus Jack just confirmed that the aforementioned Air Force 1 release will be accompanied by matching apparel. Both the “GTA 6” Air Force 1 Lows and the apparel range will feature designs inspired by the game, featuring the “Five Star” and camo graphics throughout, GTA 6 branding, and elastic money bands. The “GTA 6” Cactus Jack x Nike Air Force 1 Lows have been unveiled in the model’s classic “Triple White” and “Triple Black” color schemes as well as a more limited purple and camo makeup teased by Travis earlier this month.

The Travis Scott x Nike x Grand Theft Auto VI collection had a tentative release date of November 21st but could shock drop at any moment so keep an eye on your SNKRS app going forward.

item.title: Pooh Shiesty Reportedly Lost 30 Pounds In Texas Jail
item.dc:creator: Matty Willz
item.description: Pooh Shiesty's attorney claims the Memphis rapper lost 30 pounds in solitary confinement at a Texas jail, citing harsh conditions and isolation affecting his mental health while awaiting trial.
item.content:encoded:
Pooh Shiesty’s Attorney Details Harsh Jail Conditions

Memphis rapper Pooh Shiesty is reportedly dealing with serious physical and mental challenges behind bars, according to his attorney.

The 27-year-old rapper, born Lontrell Williams Jr., allegedly lost approximately 30 pounds while spending months in solitary confinement at Rolling Plains Regional Jail in Haskell, Texas.

| Biggest Takeaways From Pooh Shiesty’s New Album ‘All Eyes On Shiest’

According to KTXS News, attorney Kent Schaffer claims his client spent 23 hours a day confined to his cell after being transferred to the facility in July.

Schaffer says the isolation severely affected the rapper’s sleep and overall well-being.

| Pooh Shiesty’s Bond Request Denied By Judge Amid Gucci Mane Kidnapping Case

“His sleep patterns were way off. He had lost about 30 pounds,” Schaffer told KTXS. “It was just mentally wearing him down because he has no contact with people other than through an iPad in short bursts of video visits.”

Federal Judge Intervenes As Shiesty Awaits Trial

The attorney also questioned the jail’s justification for keeping Shiesty isolated. Officials reportedly cited concerns about his safety, although Schaffer maintains the rapper has no documented history of violence while incarcerated.

In one unusual incident, three inmates allegedly attempted to enter the solitary confinement area to get Shiesty’s autograph.

Another incident reportedly involved a jail-issued iPad. Schaffer claims a correctional officer gave Shiesty the device, only for guards to search his cell hours later and discipline him for possessing it.

The rapper’s family has also faced challenges maintaining contact. According to Schaffer, relatives traveling from Memphis endured an 18-hour round trip for visits lasting just one hour.

However, Shiesty’s legal team recently secured a significant victory.

On November 10, U.S. District Judge David C. Godbey granted an emergency motion addressing the rapper’s confinement conditions. The decision cleared the way for Shiesty to be transferred to another facility.

The ruling does not mean the rapper is being released from federal custody.

Shiesty remains behind bars as he awaits trial in connection with allegations involving fellow rapper Gucci Mane. Federal prosecutors accuse Shiesty and several others of participating in an armed confrontation at a Dallas recording studio involving a dispute over his recording contract.

Shiesty has pleaded not guilty to the charges.

His trial is currently scheduled to begin February 22, 2027, in Dallas.

Meanwhile, the allegations surrounding his treatment have raised questions about the conditions he has endured while awaiting trial. KTXS reports that Rolling Plains Regional Jail has not responded to multiple requests for comment.

item.dc:creator: paige.boyd
item.description: Harlem, NY rapper and creative Vinny Cha$e has reportedly passed away at the age of 40. Longtime collaborator Kid Art posted a tribute on Instagram, sharing that he reportedly died on Monday (Nov. 16) from a car accident. “One of the most special souls we’ve ever known, he gave so much to us and to […]
item.content:encoded:
Harlem, NY rapper and creative Vinny Cha$e has reportedly passed away at the age of 40.

Longtime collaborator Kid Art posted a tribute on Instagram, sharing that he reportedly died on Monday (Nov. 16) from a car accident. “One of the most special souls we’ve ever known, he gave so much to us and to the game. A true pioneer, his talent, charisma, and style helped shape many careers and became a blueprint for so much of what you see today. Iykyk,” he shared.

A subsequent IG post said a small funeral will be held in Pennsylvania on Thursday, and that a gathering will also be held in Manhattan this weekend.

Born Lanelle M. Hector, Vinny Cha$e (who also rapped as V. Cha$e) was a member of the Cheer$ Club collective, specializing in film, music, and fashion. He got his start as a director, shooting music videos and documentaries for the likes of Juelz Santana, Kid Cudi and more.

Switching over to the music side, he released his debut mixtape, The Plaza, in 2011. He has consistently dropped music over the next decade and a half with Cheer$ Club affiliates. The collective’s most recent project, CHEERS CLUB LISTENING SESSION Vol. 1 (Live From The Mercer), just dropped a week prior to his death.

“He took a chance on this dream, and people connected to what we made,” Kid Art said in his IG post. “After finally releasing some music again, we’re grateful his fans got one last glimpse of his gift before he left.”

Kid Art concludes, “This has rocked us to our core. We’ll carry his legacy forward and let his spirit make us better. Thank you for all the love. We love you forever, brother.”

item.title: Looze Cannon: The Detroit Rapper Behind Big Michael Michael
item.dc:creator: T.E. Thomas
item.description: Looze Cannon went from rejected child star to TikTok sensation with 2M followers in a month. His viral success came from decades of hustle, reinvention, and refusing to quit—proving overnight success is built on years of preparation.
item.content:encoded:
Before Looze Cannon pressed the button that changed his life, he prayed.

“I literally, just before I hit the live button on TikTok, I remember it, I just asked God, I said, if this is where I belong, can I get a sign tonight?” he told host Brianna during a recent interview on 97.9 The Beat. “And when I hit the live button, we here.”

“Here” is a place few creators reach. In under a month, the Detroit-born entertainer known as Looze Cannon gained nearly 2 million TikTok followers. By comparison, it took him two years to build 1 million on Instagram. The numbers are the headline, but they are not the story. The story is the three decades of training, rejection, and hustle that prepared him to be ready when his moment came.

East Side Roots

Looze Cannon’s foundation was built on the East Side of Detroit. He describes a close neighborhood where “everybody was family” and hip-hop lived in everyday life. Rap battles happened at school. Ciphers formed on the block. Kris Kross and Naughty by Nature played in the background of his childhood.

Music was also in his blood. “My father’s worked for Prince,” he said. “My mother sung background for Jermaine Jackson. My mother sung background for Stevie Wonder.”

That lineage connects him to some of the most important names in Black music history. It also explains why his entertainment instincts feel natural, not manufactured. He calls himself the family class clown, a gifted improviser who learned to read a room long before he learned to read an algorithm.

Signed at 8, Dropped Without Explanation

Most artists spend years chasing a major-label deal. Looze Cannon had one before he reached middle school. At just 8 years old, he signed with Universal. Then, right after the first album came out, the label dropped him with no explanation.

For a child, that kind of rejection could end a dream. For him, it became a lesson in how the music business really works.

He did not stop performing. Instead, he reinvented himself as “MC Glenn, the rapping Birthday Clown,” working parties so he could keep earning money doing what he loved. It is a detail that makes people laugh, but it reveals something serious: a refusal to wait for permission.

As an adult, he took a job building cars at a Chrysler plant, a role familiar to generations of Detroit families. Eventually, he walked away to bet on himself. For three to four years, he created content full-time from his basement, logging long hours with no guarantee anyone would watch.

The Move to TikTok

The turning point came from an unexpected source. After hearing advice from artist DDG, Looze Cannon shifted his focus to TikTok.

The start was rough. On his first day, the platform restricted his account. His raw comedy style ran into TikTok’s community guidelines, and he had to adjust quickly. He did. He kept his energy, sharpened his approach, and learned to work within the rules without losing his voice.

Brianna credited him with bringing real entertainment back to TikTok battles, including live freestyle rapping. Looze Cannon, in turn, made sure to honor the people who helped him early. He gave a shout-out to Detroit artist Skilla Baby, the first to offer him performance opportunities.

“Big Michael” and the Character Universe

The content that set the internet on fire was a Michael Jackson AI filter. Fans know the persona as “Big Michael,” and Looze Cannon is clear about what it is and what it is not.

“There’s a lot of impersonators,” he said, “but I’m not an impersonator. I’m just a person who put on an AI filter and is being Looze Cannon.”

His goal, he explained, was to imagine a side of the King of Pop the public rarely saw. “We only know the public figure Mike, but you hear stories about Mike being a funny person,” he said. “So I just wanted to bring my own perspective of what he possibly would be like on his funny time.”

Big Michael is only part of the lineup. Looze Cannon also performs as Uncle Luce and Ms. Bernice, characters that feel familiar to anyone who grew up around a lively Black family gathering. It is that sense of recognition, rooted in shared culture rather than stereotype, that keeps audiences coming back.

A Prophecy on Wax

One of the most striking details from the interview has nothing to do with TikTok. About three years ago, Looze Cannon released an album titled Now or Never. On it, he rapped about Michael Jackson.

At the time, nobody could have predicted that an MJ-inspired persona would make him a viral star. Looking back, he sees the project as prophetic, a case of speaking his future into existence before it arrived.

Now the music is reaching new ears. He has heard his song on the radio. He has also watched Chris Brown dance to his track, a co-sign that carries real weight in R&B and hip-hop circles.

Snoop Dogg on the Line

The support has not stopped there. Looze Cannon shared that Snoop Dogg called him personally to offer encouragement. For an artist who grew up on hip-hop’s golden era, a call from one of the culture’s most respected figures is more than a career milestone. It is confirmation that he belongs.

He was careful, however, not to let the attention change him. He said he keeps a “ground zero” work ethic and prefers to work only with good, humble people. In an industry known for inflated egos, that choice stands out.

Independence Over Hype

With fame comes offers. Looze Cannon confirmed that labels have reached out. His answer reflects everything he learned as an 8-year-old who was signed and dropped.

He is focused on independence and ownership. Rather than jumping at a traditional record deal, he prefers working with private investors who allow him to keep control of his work. The reason is personal: his 2-year-old son.

For him, success is not measured by a single viral season. It is measured by what he leaves behind. Building generational wealth and a lasting legacy is the priority, a goal that resonates deeply across Black communities where ownership has long been denied or delayed.

What Comes Next

Looze Cannon’s ambitions are broad. He points to Jamie Foxx as a model: a comedian, actor, and musician who moved between lanes without being boxed in. He is working on new singles and planning a record-breaking 24-hour TikTok livestream.

He also has a vision for the stage. His dream is to headline a tour featuring Detroit artists, bringing the city’s talent along with him rather than leaving it behind.

To close the interview, he delivered an on-the-spot a cappella freestyle using prompts from Brianna, including “The Brianna Show” and “97.9 The Beat.” He also cleared up the origin of his name. Cannon is his real last name. “Looze” came from his childhood, when he was a wild kid who was always outside.

Positive Energy as Strategy

Viral fame brings critics, and Looze Cannon has seen plenty. His response is simple.

“I just fight negative with positive, you know, and that’s all,” he said. “I never like to exchange the same energy.”

For creators who fear the camera, his advice is to block out the noise and focus on the work. That mindset carried him from birthday parties to a factory floor to a basement setup, and finally to millions of screens.

Keep Creating

Looze Cannon’s rise is being told as an overnight success. It was not. It was a child signed and dropped, a young man performing in a clown suit, a factory worker who took a risk, and an artist who kept creating long before anyone was watching.

His final message to aspiring creators applies to anyone with a dream and no guarantees.

“Don’t let nobody tell you that you a small creator, big creator. A creator is a creator,” he said. “Keep creating and be you.”

item.title: Faizon Love Sued For Allegedly Taking $6K And Ghosting Comedy Show
item.dc:creator: Stephen A. Crockett Jr.
item.description: Faizon Love is facing a lawsuit after allegedly collecting thousands of dollars for a comedy show he never bothered to attend. Event promoter Inga Harden told TMZ that she booked the comedian for a July 17 benefit event supporting local businesses in Florence, Alabama. The agreed-upon price was $12,500 for at least an hour of […]
item.content:encoded:
Faizon Love is facing a lawsuit after allegedly collecting thousands of dollars for a comedy show he never bothered to attend.

Event promoter Inga Harden told TMZ that she booked the comedian for a July 17 benefit event supporting local businesses in Florence, Alabama. The agreed-upon price was $12,500 for at least an hour of comedy, and Harden says she paid Love $6,250 upfront to secure his appearance.

Unfortunately, the laughs apparently weren’t included in the deal.

According to the lawsuit, Harden began getting nervous after learning about Love’s ongoing child support troubles. She contacted his agent, Eric Young, through her attorney to confirm that the comedian was still planning to show up. Young allegedly questioned why everyone was “panicking.”

But things reportedly took an even stranger turn 11 days before the event when an attorney representing a woman seeking child support from Love contacted Harden. The attorney allegedly demanded that she withhold part of Love’s payment and warned that she could face legal sanctions if she failed to comply.

Love ultimately failed to appear, according to the complaint, and Harden claims nobody from his team bothered to notify her that he wasn’t coming.

The comedian’s child support issues are nothing new. Love was arrested in Florida in June on contempt of court charges stemming from a dispute with Tiffany Lee, who reportedly claims he owes approximately $250,000 in child support.

Harden says she attempted to recover her $6,250 deposit but couldn’t get anyone to return her money. Instead, she allegedly received a mysterious $1 Cash App payment days later, followed by a text from Young asking her to verify her account. The lawsuit doesn’t identify who sent the dollar.

Now Harden is suing Love, Young and Young’s company, seeking $6,436.50 in remaining deposit money and fees, along with additional damages.

Love has yet to publicly address the allegations.

Apparently, the only thing that showed up for this comedy show was the lawsuit. And somebody was $1 richer.

item.content:encoded:

Well, not as a playable character, but you can apparently catch some of Drizzy’s music while cruising around in the game. Several streamers have crashed out after hearing the OVO rapper pop up during gameplay, leading to some hilarious reactions.

So far, three Drake records have been spotted, “Hold On, We’re Going Home,” “Nokia” and “Nonstop.” Contributing to a solid soundtrack the game has displayed thus far.

The reactions have been priceless, with some fans clearly not expecting to hear Drake while playing. Some gamers are trying to enjoy the mission, while others are more interested in turning the car radio up.

It has not been confirmed whether Drake will also appear on the official Grand Theft Auto VI album.

The news also comes as Drake finds himself in the Grammy conversation despite choosing not to submit his latest albums for consideration. His contribution to Karol G’s “Ahi” earned him a nomination for Best Latin Song, even after he made his feelings about the Recording Academy clear on ICEMAN.

“This album, I’m never submittin’ it/’Cause I know that they’ll never consider it./This might be the one year I won/’Cause I know how they like to position it,”

item.title: Offset Says He’s In A Good Place With Both Cardi B & Stefon Diggs
item.dc:creator: O Mazariego
item.description: After years of taking blatant and subliminal shots at each other on social media posts and stories, it seems like Offset and Cardi B might actually be on good terms… at least on Offset”s part. According to TMZ, Cardi B’s ex-husband and baby daddy stopped by Tony Yayo and Uncle Murda’s podcast, The Real Report, […]
item.content:encoded:
After years of taking blatant and subliminal shots at each other on social media posts and stories, it seems like Offset and Cardi B might actually be on good terms… at least on Offset”s part.

According to TMZ, Cardi B’s ex-husband and baby daddy stopped by Tony Yayo and Uncle Murda’s podcast, The Real Report, and when he was asked about his co-parenting situation with the very outspoken Cardi B, Offset revealed that the two are on good terms saying there’s “No issues. We grown adults… everything is sweet spot.”

Well, that’s good to know. He even seems to be okay with Cardi’s famous NFL superstar boo, Stefon Diggs whom Tony Yayo asked if he ever wanted to “f*ck up.”

“Hell naw. Ain’t no hard feelings,” Offset said. “Player to player, hell, I done did that… I’m him.”

Whether or not Cardi B agrees with Offset’s assertion that the two (or three?) are okay with where they’re at in their relationship remains to be seen but as far as Offset is concerned, everything’s on the up and up and there’s no issues to be hashed out amongst them.

Check out the clip of Offset’s responses to Yayo and Murda’s questions about his relationship with Cardi B and Stefon Diggs and let us know if your thoughts in the comments section below.
